_meta.title: Session 43 — NVIDIA Nemotron developer page deep-mine: 4 NEW family announcements (Nemotron RAG + Parse + Speech + Safety) with frontier benchmark coverage
_meta.context: User-provided https://developer.nvidia.com/nemotron landing page. Main page is description-only (no score tables). Found 4 NEW Nemotron families not in our DB: Nemotron RAG (retrieval/embedding/reranking — ViDoRe/MMTEB leaderboard leaders), Nemotron Parse (document vision — OmniDocBench), Nemotron Speech (ASR/TTS/S2S — Parakeet-TDT), Nemotron Safety (moderation/PII/jailbreak). Triple scores harvested by parallel research agent across HuggingFace model cards (nvidia/* org), arxiv 2511.20478 (Nemotron-Parse 1.1), NVIDIA developer blog (Nemotron Vision RAG and Guardrail Models). Sub-pages developer.nvidia.com/nemotron-rag/-parse/-speech/-safety all 404 — actual data lives on HF model cards + blog + tech reports. Selective cherry-pick (7 of 12 found new models + 11 of 24 found new benchmarks) to keep frontier-relevant + standard-bench-focused; skipped niche metrics (VDR rerank-pipeline, MIRACL/MLDR/BEIR-TechQA rerank-only, throughput, MMTEB Borda votes, OmniDocBench Text/Table sub-NED, Nemotron-Parse TC variant, Nemotron-OCR English-only sub, streaming-en sub-variant, older Safety Guard).
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Each triple agent-extracted from a single primary source (HF model cards + arxiv) with model + benchmark + value appearing together. Lower-is-better metrics (WER, NED) flagged in unit field; project SOTA harness supports min-based detection (per memory feedback_lower_better_sota_fix). EXCLUDED niche/sub-variant entries: VDR/BEIR-TechQA/MIRACL/MLDR pipeline-dependent recall (rerank-only), OmniDocBench sub-NED for Text/Table, throughput pages/s, MMTEB v2 Borda votes (non-standard metric), Nemotron-Parse TC variant (near-duplicate of Parse 1.1), Nemotron-OCR English-only model (subset of multilingual), Nemotron-Speech streaming-en sub (sub-variant of parakeet family), Llama 3.1 Nemotron Safety Guard 8B V3 (single aggregate accuracy 84.2%, no per-bench split), Nemotron 3 Content Safety 4B (single 84% F1).

models.name: Nemotron-ColEmbed-VL-8B-v2

models.name: Nemotron-ColEmbed-VL-4B-v2
